title: Ashes of Dried Fey Flower
summary: Combine with any Essence to create Hag’s Bane.

fields.Crafting: This unique extract is found in a safe in Old Garlow’s Place. The source lists no way to craft it.
fields.Base value: 8 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
